title: A Comprehensive Survey of Electric Vehicle Charging Demand Forecasting Techniques
venue: IEEE Open Journal of Vehicular Technology
key_value: Broad taxonomy of EV charging-demand forecasting techniques; useful as the initial citation backbone.
known_limitation: Survey coverage must be checked against 2025–2026 developments.

title: Machine Learning-Based Electric Vehicle Charging Demand Forecasting: A Systematized Literature Review
key_value: Recent structured review with emphasis on machine-learning methods, data and unresolved adaptation issues.
known_limitation: Review quality and database coverage require full-text appraisal.

title: A Review of Electric Vehicle Charging Demand Forecasting Models by Prediction Horizon: A Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis Approach
key_value: Maps model suitability to prediction horizon and helps prevent mixing incompatible forecasting tasks.
known_limitation: May not deeply cover the newest decision-focused and generative work.

title: ACN-Data: Analysis and Applications of an Open EV Charging Dataset
key_value: Canonical open session-level dataset with connection, disconnection, delivered energy and pilot signals.
known_limitation: Campus/workplace behavior does not represent all public fast-charging stations.

title: ACN-Sim: An Open-Source Simulator for Data-Driven Electric Vehicle Charging Research
dataset_or_context: ACN session replay and charging-network constraints
key_value: Provides a reproducible bridge from session forecasts to feasible charging schedules.
known_limitation: Network and behavior assumptions must be matched to the chosen deployment scenario.

title: UrbanEV: An Open Benchmark Dataset for Urban Electric Vehicle Charging Demand Prediction
dataset_or_context: Shenzhen public charging stations; raw 5-min and processed data
key_value: Large Chinese urban benchmark with temporal, spatial, weather, POI and price-related attributes plus baseline code.
known_limitation: Processed charging volume partly depends on rated-power assumptions; session-level flexibility is unavailable.

title: A City-scale and Harmonized Dataset for Global Electric Vehicle Charging Demand Analysis
prediction_target: duration, volume and related charging demand
dataset_or_context: Six cities across six continents, Apr–Sep 2023
key_value: Best current public candidate for strict leave-one-city-out generalization and federated cross-city experiments.
known_limitation: Only six months and harmonized hourly aggregates; cannot provide true vehicle-level flexibility labels.

title: A high-resolution electric vehicle charging transaction dataset with multidimensional features in China
prediction_target: transactions, arrival, duration, energy and related behavior
key_value: High-value Chinese session dataset with timestamps, energy, price, status, termination reason and weather.
known_limitation: Public metadata must be checked to determine whether plug-in and departure windows are separately observable.

title: A dataset for multi-faceted analysis of electric vehicle charging transactions
key_value: Supports analysis from both charger and user perspectives and may enable heterogeneity studies.
known_limitation: Field completeness and direct power-series availability require data inspection.

title: Electric vehicle charging stations in the workplace with high-resolution data from casual and habitual users
dataset_or_context: One-year corporate campus; second-level transaction timestamps
key_value: Useful for destination/workplace flexibility because habitual and casual charging behavior can be separated.
known_limitation: Single corporate-campus context limits external validity.

title: High-temporal-resolution dataset of uni-, bidirectional, and dynamic electric vehicle charging profiles
prediction_target: high-frequency charging profiles and SoC response
dataset_or_context: 142 laboratory charging profiles; 8 EVs; AC/DC; V2G
key_value: High-fidelity resource for within-session profile physics and V2G model validation.
known_limitation: Laboratory scale and small vehicle count are unsuitable for city-level demand forecasting by themselves.

title: A city-scale dataset of public electric vehicle charging transactions and infrastructure
prediction_target: public charging transactions and infrastructure demand
dataset_or_context: 8.544 million transactions; 8,553 Beijing stations; Jan and Jul 2025
key_value: Very large, recent Chinese public-charging dataset suitable for city-scale heterogeneity and seasonal contrast.
known_limitation: Only two sampled months are reported; detailed power trajectories and flexibility labels require inspection.

title: An AI-Augmented Dataset of Multi-Prototype Electric Vehicle Charging Load Profiles in China
key_value: Useful for evaluating whether synthetic augmentation improves rare-pattern and cross-prototype forecasting.
known_limitation: AI-augmented data must not be treated as independent real-world evidence without provenance analysis.

title: EV2Gym: A Flexible V2G Simulator for EV Smart Charging Research and Benchmarking
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
key_value: Strong candidate for evaluating forecast-to-dispatch value under configurable smart-charging and V2G scenarios.
known_limitation: Synthetic behavior distributions need calibration against the selected real dataset.

title: A benchmark of electric vehicle load and occupancy models for day-ahead forecasting on open charging session data
key_value: Provides an essential benchmark against over-complex models and clarifies load-versus-occupancy targets.
known_limitation: Predates the latest foundation, diffusion and OOD methods.

title: Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment Day-Ahead Power Forecast Based on Deep Learning and the Attention Mechanism
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
key_value: Representative recent attention-based day-ahead EVSE power forecasting baseline.
known_limitation: Architecture-centric contribution may not address deployment shift or decision value.

title: Electric vehicles load forecasting for day-ahead market participation using machine and deep learning methods
key_value: Directly connects forecast quality with day-ahead market participation rather than reporting accuracy alone.
known_limitation: Need full text to inspect uncertainty treatment and causal separation between forecast and scheduling.

title: Short-term electric vehicle charging demand prediction: A deep learning approach
key_value: Widely relevant deep-learning reference for short-term charging demand prediction.
known_limitation: Must be compared against newer spatiotemporal and probabilistic models.

title: Electric vehicle charging demand forecasting using a heterogeneous spatio-temporal graph convolutional network
key_value: Key reference for heterogeneous spatiotemporal interactions across charging stations.
known_limitation: Static or learned graph generalization to unseen stations/cities must be assessed.

title: A physics-informed and attention-based graph learning approach for regional electric vehicle charging demand prediction
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
key_value: Important comparator for claims involving physical priors and graph-based regional prediction.
known_limitation: Physical information may act as engineered structure rather than guaranteeing OOD robustness.

title: Physics-informed graph learning for citywide electric vehicle charging demand prediction and pricing
key_value: Connects graph forecasting with price-related operational analysis.
known_limitation: Need full text to distinguish predictive contribution from pricing application.

title: Feature-enhanced probabilistic forecasting of electric vehicle charging demand
key_value: Core peer-reviewed comparator for probabilistic charging-demand forecasting and feature design.
known_limitation: Calibration under temporal or spatial distribution shift requires separate evaluation.

title: ChatEV: A large language model-powered framework for electric vehicle charging demand prediction
key_value: Representative LLM-oriented charging-demand study; useful for judging whether foundation-model claims are substantive.
known_limitation: Full-text review is required before using it as evidence for generalization or interpretability.

title: An adaptive spatio-temporal graph recurrent network for short-term electric vehicle charging demand forecasting
key_value: Recent adaptive graph baseline that questions simplistic geography-only adjacency.
known_limitation: Adaptive graph quality on unseen stations and cities must be independently tested.

title: Explainable spatiotemporal multi-task learning for electric vehicle charging demand prediction
key_value: Important recent reference for joint targets and explainability rather than a single load curve.
known_limitation: Explainability validity and causal interpretation require careful appraisal.

title: Multi-step electric vehicle charging load forecasting using an Autoformer-derived model
key_value: Representative modern Transformer baseline for multi-step forecasting.
known_limitation: Exact title and method naming should be refreshed from Crossref before citation.

title: Data-driven integrated learning for electric vehicle charging load forecasting
key_value: Recent ensemble/integrated-learning comparator relevant to the project requirement for heterogeneous submodels.
known_limitation: Need to determine whether model heterogeneity is principled or architecture stacking.

title: VisionEV: Multimodal large language model for electric vehicle charging demand forecasting with satellite imagery
key_value: Frontier peer-reviewed multimodal reference for evaluating the value of exogenous spatial imagery.
known_limitation: High model/data cost may not translate to operational gains or OOD robustness.

title: TriCast: Tri-modal causal learning for electric vehicle charging demand forecasting
key_value: Recent causal/multimodal direction worth monitoring for claims about invariant drivers.
known_limitation: Causal identification assumptions must be inspected in full text.

title: WeTRaC: Weather-aware transformer for electric truck charging demand forecasting
key_value: Shows that vehicle class and operational context can define a distinct forecasting problem.
known_limitation: Fleet/depot results may not transfer to public passenger-vehicle stations.

title: DiffCharge: Generating EV Charging Scenarios via a Denoising Diffusion Model
key_value: Canonical diffusion-based EV charging scenario generator with open code and market-oriented evaluation.
known_limitation: Scenario realism does not automatically imply calibrated forecasts or robustness under shift.

title: Scalable probabilistic estimates of electric vehicle charging given observed driver behavior
prediction_target: charging demand conditional on driver behavior
key_value: Foundational reference for behavior-conditioned scalable probabilistic EV charging estimates.
known_limitation: Must be compared with modern deep generative and online adaptation methods.

title: Probability density function forecasting of residential electric vehicles charging profile
key_value: Core probability-density benchmark predating diffusion models.
known_limitation: Residential context differs from station-level public or workplace charging.

title: Integrated deep learning framework for electric vehicles' flexibility forecasting and optimal dispatch
key_value: Closest known peer-reviewed predecessor to joint flexibility forecasting and dispatch; mandatory before claiming novelty.
known_limitation: Direct boundary forecasting may not represent all session-level causal structure; full text is required.

title: Deep learning predicts real-world electric vehicle direct current charging profiles and durations
key_value: Sets a high bar for within-session DC fast-charging prediction, real-time updating and scale.
known_limitation: Underlying dataset is proprietary/NDA-restricted, limiting independent data reproduction.

title: Participation of electric vehicle charging station aggregators in the day-ahead market using demand forecasting and uncertainty pricing
key_value: Relevant for designing economic value metrics beyond MAE/RMSE.
known_limitation: Must separate forecast innovation from market formulation innovation.

title: Online decoupling feature framework for optimal probabilistic load forecasting in concept drift environments
dataset_or_context: General load forecasting under concept drift
key_value: High-relevance methodological reference for online probabilistic forecasting under concept drift.
known_limitation: Not EV-specific; transfer assumptions must be justified experimentally.

title: Fine-grained electric vehicle charging demand prediction
key_value: Earlier fine-grained prediction reference for tracing the evolution of spatial granularity.
known_limitation: Venue and experimental rigor require full appraisal before heavy citation.

title: Coherent Hierarchical Probabilistic Forecasting of Electric Vehicle Charging Demand
open_access: publisher record / author version to verify
key_value: Shows that differentiable probabilistic reconciliation for coherent station–aggregate EV forecasts is already established.
known_limitation: Small hierarchy; no strict unseen-city/station OOD or downstream dispatch-risk study.

title: Forecasting Load-Shifting Flexibility of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations for Model Predictive Control
prediction_target: immediate profile, latest-feasible profile and occupancy
key_value: Establishes the immediate/latest/occupancy envelope plus MPC combination and reports 3.4%–4.3% cost reduction.
known_limitation: No calibrated joint uncertainty, strict OOD protocol or session-level feasible-set validation.

title: Forecasting What Matters: Decision-Focused RL for Controlled EV Charging with Unknown Departure Times
dataset_or_context: hospital parking sessions; statistically generated train/test sessions
key_value: Decision feedback to an EV forecaster is already formalized; reported up to 14% reward gain and 55% lower unsupplied energy versus RL without forecasts.
known_limitation: Single-EV binary charging, soft constraints, one price profile; no aggregate probabilistic/OOD setting.

title: Enhancing Grid Balancing Services from Electric Vehicle Aggregators under Uncertainty: A Probability-Guaranteed Feasible Region Approach
key_value: Probability/confidence-guaranteed EV aggregate feasible-region disclosure is already occupied.
known_limitation: Model/distribution-assumption driven; no real charging forecast benchmark or finite-sample OOD calibration.

title: Mind the Gap: Modelling Difference between Censored and Uncensored Electric Vehicle Charging Demand
prediction_target: true latent charging demand rather than observed served demand
dataset_or_context: Copenhagen GPS counterfactual EV study with queue and competitor censoring
key_value: Shows observed charging records can be supply-censored; reported censoring up to 61% in some areas and proposed Tobit/censored-quantile graph models.
known_limitation: Latent truth comes from a counterfactual ICE-trajectory simulation; real operational identifiability remains difficult.

title: Dynamic Incentives for Electric Vehicles Charging at Supermarket Stations: Causal Insights on Demand Flexibility
prediction_target: causal charging-demand response to discount interventions
key_value: Connects bilevel incentive design with double machine learning; real pilot reports heterogeneous causal demand response.
known_limitation: Causal generalization to unseen tariffs, stations and user populations is not established.

title: Deep-Learning-Based Probabilistic Forecasting of Electric Vehicle Charging Load With a Novel Queuing Model
dataset_or_context: actual traffic-flow data plus probabilistic queue model
key_value: Queue- and service-limitation-aware probabilistic charging-load forecasting is established prior art.
known_limitation: Not a modern multi-station OOD benchmark; latent rejected demand and spatial substitution are not fully observed.

title: Location-Based Probabilistic Load Forecasting of Electric Vehicle Charging Sites: Deep Transfer Learning with Multi-quantile Temporal Convolutional Network
dataset_or_context: Caltech, JPL, Office-1 and NREL; two-week target adaptation
key_value: Probabilistic cross-location transfer with only two weeks of target data is already demonstrated.
known_limitation: Not zero-shot; only four sites and no explicit support-overlap or abstention mechanism.
